name: Italian Sentenze / Atti Giudiziari
description: Italian court judgments and judicial acts (sentenze, decreti, verbali, atti di stato civile). Detects codice fiscale (personal and company), partita IVA, cadastral references (foglio, particella, subalterno, categoria), vehicle plates, civil-registry act references (nr. / Parte / Serie / anno), Italian dates in numeric and spelled-out form, phone numbers and IBAN. Court names, laws and decree numbers are not matched, so citations stay readable.

patterns.name: Partita IVA
patterns.description: Company tax code / VAT number, matched only after C.F. / P.IVA context to avoid random 11-digit numbers

patterns.name: Catasto
patterns.description: Cadastral references: foglio (di mappa), particella, mappale, subalterno, and the cadastral category such as cat. A/1.

patterns.name: Targa veicolo
patterns.description: Italian vehicle plate, current format AB123CD

patterns.name: Atto civile
patterns.description: Civil registry act references (marriage, birth): nr. 12 Parte II Serie A anno 2000

patterns.name: Data
patterns.description: Dates as DD/MM/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, DD-MM-YY and with the month written out (1° gennaio 2023).

patterns.name: Telefono
patterns.description: Italian landline and mobile numbers, optional +39

patterns.name: Numero RG
patterns.description: Case docket number. Off by default: often needs to stay legible in citations

patterns.name: CAP
patterns.description: 5-digit postal code. Off by default: matches any standalone 5-digit number
